## Notes

TRELLIS: Structured LATent (sparse voxels with vision-foundation-model features); up to 2B parameters; ~500K 3D objects; decodes to radiance fields, 3D Gaussians, meshes; repo lists MIT license, 16 GB GPU, CVPR'25 spotlight.
